binding_rules.declarative_constraint: All four families are values embedded at their exact frozen original REQUIREMENTS-ONLY/P02–P08 field position. Shared declarations are nested only, never standalone inputs. No outer keys/kind/order or parser source changes.
For F01, wrapper role_id must equal the exact enclosing original field ID, not merely belong to the two-name family allowed set.

For F02, every direct list element role_id must equal the exact enclosing original field ID. There is no wrapper role, first-element inference, wrapper extraction, sorting, deduplication or automatic status aggregation.
For a non-null F03 or required F04 reference, role_id must equal the exact enclosing original field ID. F03 outer null stays unknown/HOLD; F04 outer null needs prospective refusal.

A reference context_identity denotes the role policy/completeness context C(role), not the referenced artifact origin. When C(role) is uniquely declared and non-null, require exact typed equality of all four documentary identity fields. If either identity is unknown/null, HOLD; never accept null-equals-null as known equality.

For F01, namespace_identity must have the same exact non-null documentary identity as unique C(role) declaring its complete member namespace. Unknown/null context or namespace stays HOLD; member hashes or known counts do not fill the gap.

C(role) is a separate uninstantiated declaration obligation, not a runtime input format, resolver API or actual catalog. No declaration, unavailable bytes, multiple matches or conflicting identities preserve uncertainty and refuse dependent progress; no first/last/newest or inferred context. Documentary identity equality does not authenticate content/completeness/authority.

V2 reference and F01 wrapper literal markers/revision2 are exact proposed local values. Identity retains the unchanged v1 exact-byte declaration. No silent v1 reference conversion, source bridge, original parser modification or current field-specific validation is supplied.

requirement_coverage.parent_normative_requirement: Declare the exact separately reviewed namespace, version and complete allowed member set before any future format can claim membership. Current upload/runtime/cache/supervisor/control and historical namespaces stay distinct; unknown/missing/extra names never default.

A later local definition must specify member spelling, canonicalization and duplicate rules and exactly which original bytes each digest/length identifies. A path, public version or re-encoded JSON digest cannot silently substitute for the declared immutable artifact.

Declare context-specific key/count/name/digest limits and refusal order independently of the current JSON object bound. Do not truncate/filter a complete namespace to fit a draft limit or open a source bridge.

Require a separately reviewed element identity/reference vocabulary for each field role before populated-reference parsing. No shared loose reference dictionary, implicit file/network resolver or source_reviewed boolean substitutes.

Each role must declare its count bound, ordering and duplicate/alias policy from its authoritative context. Preserve original ordered prefixes and distinct evidence dimensions; do not sort, deduplicate, merge or truncate silently. Array64 alone is not semantic completeness.

An empty, well-shaped or bounded list proves no complete history, owned clock, held/death/status/closure fact or completed role. Preserve partial/unknown evidence and require independent scope/completeness joins for every claim.

A future local definition must distinguish null, absent target, unavailable evidence, malformed reference and known documentary identity. Null in these two nullable roles stays unknown/HOLD and never means absent real work, confirmed idle or permission.

A unique exact documentary reference can identify supplied bytes only. It cannot establish a fresh operational user decision, unconsumed durable authority, physical process owner/domain or continuing clock.

Before any separately authorized resolver or new validation effect, review ownership from first allocation/read and preserve primary exceptions, partial records and original refusal order. No new resolver, I/O or timing is supplied here.

For the two required-reference roles, a later local format must explicitly refuse null/malformed instances rather than invent empty/default evidence. Required outer keys alone do not implement this rule; current source remains unsupported and unchanged.

A required workload/cap reference must cover the complete immutable guarded roles and every original cap/refusal/financial hold in the applicable context. A partial source subset or selected constants cannot stand for the full domain.

A local reference match does not bind a runtime or prove complete-unit timing/memory/fresh replay/recovery/economics/calibration/data/protocol/training or financial scope. All independent real gates remain.

Later definitions must bind immutable parent/review/source identities and byte domains. No latest-path substitution or hidden mutable alias is assumed stable. This addendum chooses no instance encoding or actual member namespace.

Never select the first/last/newest reference or use truthiness/coercion to resolve absence, multiple matches, mismatch or conflicting statuses. Preserve all supplied contradictory/partial records and refuse dependent progress.

The current exact-bytes/JSON/canonical/numeric/tree bounds and field order remain source-frozen. This requirements addendum neither changes parser bounds nor proves an inverse or compatibility with any original runtime domain.

Preserve original per-profile field order and original within-process/effect/refusal order with causal joins. No total cross-process timestamp order, merged checks, omitted fresh observations or claim that missing receipt means no earlier effect.

No requirement or documentary value authorizes open/read/import/source execution, process/clock/timer/network/target/GPU/proof work. Any future resolver adds fallible nonzero work requiring separate source/refusal/lifetime review and explicit scope.

Do not reuse the consumed local48/32-case approvals or any real grant. Preserve old genuine proof/31 gradients, wholeunits0, scientific candidate-replay notstarted and every failed/partial/pending/consumed status without promotion or erasure.

No executable validator/adapter/runtime binding/gate edit, reference instance, populated example, case membership/oracle, prototype/test/benchmark or operational request follows from these requirements. Later source and execution scopes remain separate.

All24 original requirements stay NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_PROVEN; real execution/research/training false, real attempts0, bindingnull, targetHOLD and the supported budget gate closed. Preserve all science/native/guards/hash/copies/owner/durability/shutdown/continuing clocks/resources/financial holds.
